integrity: The frontier follows from an exact local linear recurrence and the second-order Jury-Schur criterion. Boundary non-attraction is witnessed by exact small-amplitude linear cycles while the box remains inactive. The bundled rational-arithmetic replay is a consistency check, not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Local exact fixed-parameter analysis of a scalar equality-constrained negative-curvature mode with an inactive box near the KKT point. It does not classify adaptive schedules, inexact solves, inequality multipliers, or multidimensional coupled KKT modes.
title: Sharp local stability frontier for fixed-parameter proximal augmented Lagrangian dynamics
